name: govuk-frontend-example-typescript
description: TypeScript line of the GDS-compliant GOV.UK Frontend template. Server-rendered HTML via Node/TypeScript + Nunjucks; no SPA UI frameworks.

scripts.verify:docs: npm run format:check && npm run lint:md
scripts.test: npm run test:baseline && npm run test:styles && npm run build:styles && c8 --all --src src --include 'src/**/*.ts' --exclude 'src/**/*.test.ts' --exclude 'src/**/*.d.ts' --exclude 'src/main.ts' --reporter=text --check-coverage --lines 100 --statements 100 --branches 100 --functions 100 -- node --import tsx --test 'src/**/*.test.ts'
scripts.verify: npm run verify:docs && npm run build:styles && npm run typecheck && npm test
